prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit this transparent six-sprite production reference sheet for Crossroads: Realms Beyond into its winter variant. Preserve EXACTLY SIX separate objects in the SAME 3 columns × 2 rows and keep each object centered in its current grid cell; keep wide transparent gutters. Preserve each object's existing architecture, roof shape, materials, scale, viewing angle, doors, windows, sign panels, emblems and equipment. Change the season only. Add convincing softly stepped snow blankets following each pitched roof and awning plane, ridges and porch roofs, with pale blue-grey undersides, irregular broken edges and patches of original tiles visible. Small snow caps on exposed chimney tops, sills, outdoor planter rims, rails and exposed ledges. Replace outdoor summer flowers/green vines/leafy planters with sparse dormant brown stems and snow; evergreen conifers may keep muted foliage beneath snow. Keep plants INSIDE the glass greenhouse green and visible: only patchy snow on roof bars and margins, not an opaque cover over all glass. Keep all entrances clear, all shop goods accessible under shelter, sign panels clean and empty exactly as the source. If an object has no roof (the little reading/book stand), use only light snow on its exposed ledges and leave books usable. Match the source's soft-edged coarse square pixel art, restrained colours and matte storybook shading. Snow also uses clear coarse pixel clusters, no blur/photorealism, no black sticker outlines, no white glow/rim around whole objects. No scenery, snowfall particles, ground plane, ground shadows, people, holiday decorations, new furniture, labels or text. Actual transparent background. Do not redesign, rearrange or merge objects. Sheet shops_a.
